title: FarikSprint
description: A sprint the human starts, worked by the team until it is planned and ends, stored as .farik/sprints/S<n>.yaml. See docs/SPEC.md sections 3, 5.2, 5.3, 5.5, 5.11, 8.4 and 8.5.

id.description: Stable identifier: one more than the highest of the sprint files' numbers and the ids in the log's sprint.started events. Assigned by the store, never edited.

started_at.description: When the human started this sprint.

ended_at.description: When this sprint ended, by itself or by the human. Absent while it is open.

budget_usd.description: What this sprint may spend before it stops taking new assignments (docs/SPEC.md 5.5). Left out, the sprint has no budget of its own (ADR 0015).

task_ids.description: The tasks this sprint holds, each once: planned into it, or joined to it because their epic is in it (docs/SPEC.md 5.11).

status.description: Whether this sprint still takes new assignments.
